title: Jada Toys Marvel Nano Metalfigs Dobby Harry Potter Mini Figure - Used
descriptionText: The Jada Toys Marvel Nano Metalfigs Mini Figure featuring Dobby from Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire is a highly detailed and collectible action figure. This officially licensed product showcases the beloved character in a compact and durable design, perfect for fans and collectors. With its high-quality construction and authentic details, this Dobby figure is a must-have for any Harry Potter enthusiast looking to add to their collection of action figures.
